name: d4-newsletter
description: Newsletter signup: an embeddable form with explicit consent, a subscribers list managed from the dashboard, one-click unsubscribe, and CSV export for whichever sending platform the owner uses. Records the consent wording, timestamp and source page against every subscriber.
clientFacingSummary: Collect email addresses from your site: subscribers land in your dashboard, can unsubscribe themselves, and export to a spreadsheet whenever you want to send something.

env.description: Shared with the site template contact form. When set with CONTACT_TO_EMAIL, the owner is notified of new subscribers.
